Hi Sara — thanks for the clear request. We're able to run a tenant-scoped clearance for ACME-TENANT-42. High-level plan and commitments below:

1) Scope & verification (within 24 hours): our ops team will validate tenant identifiers and produce a pre-run listing (non-destructive) for your approval.

2) Execution window (preferred): 2029-03-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Alternate: 2029-03-03 02:00-05:00 UTC.

3) Actions performed: remove prompt inputs, generated outputs, inference logs, and ephemeral KV cache entries tied to the tenant. We will not delete model binaries, shared telemetry, or aggregated analytics.

4) Evidence: run manifest CSV (object_id, path, hash, deletion_timestamp), execution log TXT, and a signed PDF summary. Files will be delivered via shared Drive link and attached to HubSpot ticket HS-9876543.

5) SLA: completion confirmation within 48 hours of execution; evidence retained for 90 days unless you request otherwise.

Please reply with acceptance of the window or a preferred alternate, and whether you require a notarized or notarized+stamped statement. I'll loop in Ops for the pre-run listing.

Best,
Chloe Martin
